answer: Fresh-entropy lineage checkpoints. Each identity publishes daily checkpoints at dawn containing a signature over fresh hardware randomness and prior checkpoint hash. Registry links them into a trellis; shared lineage yields matching checkpoints until divergence, exposing the clone. Duplicated lineage emits an echo in checkpoint hashes before divergence. Evasion requires unique entropy and a separate chain per sybil, costing continuous hardware, signing, and monitoring per identity.
